title: Hoffman-type Results for the Sum of k Largest Eigenvalues of a Graph
summary: Let $S_k(G)$ denote the sum of the $k$ largest eigenvalues of a graph $G$. Motivated by the classical Hoffman program for the spectral radius of a graph, we investigate an additive Hoffman-type problem for $S_k(G)$. For each fixed $k\geq 2$ and sufficiently large order $n$, we characterize all connected graphs satisfying $S_k(G)<2k$. As a consequence, we prove that the path $P_n$ is the unique minimizer of $S_k(G)$ among all connected graphs of order $n$. \vspace*{2mm} We further investigate the first Hoffman-type range \[ 2k\leq S_k(G)<2k+\sqrt{2+\sqrt5}-2. \] We completely characterize the…
